overview.description: The KraneShares 100% KWEB Defined Outcome January 2027 ETF (KPRO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the total return of the KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF (KWEB) up to a cap, with a 100% downside hedge over a two-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds shares of the underlying ETF and options to obtain exposure KPRO was launched on Feb 8, 2024 and is issued by KraneShares.
